mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dividends (user_id, portfolio_id, symbol, ex_date, pay_date, amount_per_share, quantity_at_ex_date, gross_amount_usd, net_amount_usd, withholding_rate, fx_rate, net_amount_krw, status, source, confirmed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{portfolioId}, #{symbol}, #{exDate}, #{payDate}, #{amountPerShare}, #{quantityAtExDate}, #{grossAmountUsd}, #{netAmountUsd}, #{withholdingRate}, #{fxRate}, #{netAmountKrw}, #{status}, #{source}, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CONFIRMED' THEN NOW(3) ELSE NULL END)

INSERT IGNORE INTO dividends (user_id, portfolio_id, symbol, ex_date, pay_date, amount_per_share, quantity_at_ex_date, gross_amount_usd, net_amount_usd, withholding_rate, fx_rate, net_amount_krw, status, source, confirmed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{portfolioId}, #{symbol}, #{exDate}, #{payDate}, #{amountPerShare}, #{quantityAtExDate}, #{grossAmountUsd}, #{netAmountUsd}, #{withholdingRate}, #{fxRate}, #{netAmountKrw}, #{status}, #{source}, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CONFIRMED' THEN NOW(3) ELSE NULL END)
mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, ex_date, pay_date, amount_per_share, quantity_at_ex_date, net_amount_usd, fx_rate, net_amount_krw, status, source FROM dividends WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pay_date DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, user_id, portfolio_id, symbol, ex_date, pay_date, amount_per_share, quantity_at_ex_date, gross_amount_usd, net_amount_usd, withholding_rate, fx_rate, net_amount_krw, status, source, confirmed_at FROM dividends WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE dividends SET net_amount_usd = #{netAmountUsd}, fx_rate = #{fxRate}, net_amount_krw = #{netAmountKrw}, pay_date = #{payDate}, status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ESTIMATED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dividends WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ESTIMATED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT SUM(net_amount_krw) FROM dividends WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ESTIMATED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, symbol, ex_date, pay_date, amount_per_share, quantity_at_ex_date, net_amount_usd, fx_rate, net_amount_krw, status, source FROM dividends WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND pay_date >= #{today} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pay_date ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
